system.what: A thin creature that wears stolen faces
system.weakness: Its true reflection: make it look in an old mirror
system.hiddenPlace: Behind the mirrors of a closed department store
system.signature: Borrowed Face: attack the standing witch with the most Magic left, with Hit 1 higher; on a Failure they also lose 1 Magic (the guardian loses 1 Ward instead if it takes the attack by Hold or Shield). Ties: roll a die.
